settings.heading: How often does my breathalyser need calibration?
settings.text: Most Andatech workplace breathalysers require calibration every six months or after a set number of tests — whichever comes first. The exact interval depends on your device model, usage frequency and any applicable Australian Standard or workplace policy requirements. You can check your device's calibration due date in Caltrace, or contact our service team for a recommended schedule.

settings.heading: What's covered under warranty?
settings.text: Andatech workplace devices come with a manufacturer's warranty that covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal use. The warranty period and specific coverage vary by product. Damage caused by misuse, unauthorised modification or failure to maintain calibration is generally not covered. For full warranty terms or to start a claim, visit the Warranty & Returns page or contact our support team.

settings.heading: Can I order consumables without a Caltrace account?
settings.text: Yes. Mouthpieces, calibration gas, drug test kits and other consumables are available through the Andatech online store without a Caltrace account. However, a Caltrace account lets you track orders against your devices, receive reorder reminders and manage your service history in one place.

settings.heading: What are your support hours?
settings.text: Our Australian-based support team is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5:30 PM AEST. You can reach us by phone on 1300 800 200 or through the Contact Support page. For calibration bookings and consumable orders, Caltrace is available online 24/7.
